items.title: Watch party chat
items.text: Open the Watch party menu in the player and choose Chat: a small sidebar lists the party's messages while the film plays on.

items.title: Type on a phone
items.text: On a phone or tablet, tap the field in the sidebar to open the keyboard, then tap Send. Your message reaches everyone in the party.

items.title: Chat from a TV
items.text: On a TV the sidebar shows a QR code. Scan it with a phone to open a typing page and send a message from anywhere. The page needs the watch party server updated.
